# `csharp_preserve_single_line_statements`

Allow a control-flow body the author left on its header's line to stay there.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Classify(int n)
    {
        if (n > 0)
        {
            return "positive";
        }
        else if (n < 0)
        {
            return "negative";
        }
        else
        {
            return "zero";
        }
    }
}
```

### `csharp_preserve_single_line_statements = true`

```editorconfig
csharp_preserve_single_line_statements = true
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `csharp_preserve_single_line_statements = false`

```editorconfig
csharp_preserve_single_line_statements = false
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
